title: 第9章 召唤归海一刀第10章 各势力交好
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 清风山，清风宗。
秦叶、武萱儿，万尘三人离开清风城后，很快就回到了清风宗。
清风宗位于清风山山顶，占地面积广阔，昔日风光旖旎，建筑众多，气势磅礴。但是经历过多次动荡，再加上没落后年久失修，如今变得破落不堪。
有些建筑物上虽然倒塌了，但是上面还保有战斗过的痕迹，可见当年清风宗所经历的动荡不小。
秦叶与武萱儿虽然早已经习以为常，但是现在身边带着一个外人，难免有些尴尬。
望着这破落的宗门，万尘尽管心中有些心理准备，但还是有些懵。
这清风宗混的真是太惨了，就算是万家建筑都比这个清风宗好，怪不得五大宗门会将清风宗踢出去。
只是万尘有些不明白，宗主已经是先天境高手了，这清风宗外貌环境怎么不处理一下？宗门就像房子一样，没有一点气势威严，别人必然会歧视。
“宗主，这……”万尘忍不住开口道。
秦叶拿出主宗主威严，咳了一声，说道：“我清风宗历经数百年，这些破败景象都是历史的见证，我们这些后人要时时刻刻铭记在心，为清风宗的崛起添砖加瓦。”
原来是宗主故意留下来的，万尘顿时激动起来，重重点头道：“宗主，我万尘一定不负历代前辈的重托，为宗门崛起而努力。”
“孺子可教。”秦叶满意的点了点头，心中暗道这小子还真是好忽悠，实际情况却是秦叶刚刚穿越过来，来不及收拾。而且修葺这些建筑也一笔不小的花费，宗门内值钱的东西早就被那些师兄弟给搬光了，秦叶哪还有钱去修葺啊。
当然，这些肯定是不会对万尘说的，宗门和自己的威严还是要维护的。
三人走进宗门，秦叶对武萱儿说道：“你带他去安排一个住所吧。”
“是，掌门师兄。”武萱儿应声道。
武萱儿带着万尘去了北边一处建筑，那边是弟子休息区，只见这里杂乱不堪，一些生活用品随处散落在地上。
武萱儿红着脸，解释道：“本来这里每天都是有人打扫的，只是前些天发生了一些变故，打扫的仆从暂时下山去了。”
万尘点了点头，没有说什么，他来这里是为了修炼，只要宗主真心传授，其他的他也不在乎。
武萱儿指着眼前一大片房屋，说道：“这里现在都没有人，你就选一间吧。”
“是，大长老。”万尘应了一声，便走了进去，发现弟子居室差别不是很大，于是就随便选了一间。
见万尘已经选好房间，武萱儿说道：“你现在打扫一下房间，掌门应该明天会召见你。”
说完，武萱儿就急着走了。
今天发生的事情，让她震惊不已，她也认识到自己实力不足，下定决心要短时间内突破先天，不然若是弟子们的实力超过她，她哪还有什么脸面当这个大长老。
秦叶回到卧室，急急忙忙地问系统：“系统，我收徒任务完成了，奖励呢？”
因为一直没有听到系统的提示声，所以秦叶才急急忙忙地将万尘打发走，找系统询问了起来。
“宿主，收徒任务还没有完成。”系统的声音在秦叶的耳边响起。
“系统，我不是收徒万尘吗？怎么会没有完成。”秦叶皱眉询问道。
“宿主，你只是将万尘带进宗门，还并没有收徒。”系统提醒道。
虽然是自己搞错了，但是秦叶并不着急，万尘已经进了宗门，这就像砧板上的肉，随时能收他为徒，到时系统奖励还不是他的。
content_en:
Qingfeng Mountain, Qingfeng Sect.
Qin Ye, Wu Xuan'er, and Wan Chen quickly returned to Qingfeng Sect after leaving Qingfeng City.
Qingfeng Sect is located at the top of Qingfeng Mountain, covering a vast area. It used to have beautiful scenery, many buildings and majestic momentum. However, it has experienced many turmoils and fell into disrepair after its decline, and now it has become dilapidated.
Although some buildings collapsed, there are still traces of battles on them, which shows that the Qingfeng Sect experienced a lot of turmoil back then.
Although Qin Ye and Wu Xuan'er have long been accustomed to it, it is inevitable to feel a little embarrassed now with an outsider by their side.
Looking at the dilapidated sect, Wan Chen was still a little confused even though he was mentally prepared.
The Qingfeng Sect is really miserable. Even the buildings of Wanjia are better than this Qingfeng Sect. No wonder the five major sects will kick the Qingfeng Sect out.
It's just that Wan Chen doesn't understand. The sect leader is already a master of the Xiantian realm. Why doesn't the appearance and environment of Qingfeng Sect not be dealt with? A sect is like a house. If it doesn't have any majesty, others will definitely discriminate against it.
"Sect Master, this..." Wan Chen couldn't help but say.
Qin Ye took out the majesty of the main sect, coughed, and said: "Our Qingfeng Sect has gone through hundreds of years, and these dilapidated scenes are witnesses of history. We, the descendants, must always keep it in mind and contribute to the rise of Qingfeng Sect."
It turned out that the sect master deliberately stayed here. Wan Chen suddenly became excited, nodded heavily and said: "Sect master, I, Wan Chen, will definitely live up to the trust of the predecessors of the past generations and work hard for the rise of the sect."
"You can teach me." Qin Ye nodded with satisfaction, secretly thinking that this kid was really easy to fool, but the actual situation was that Qin Ye had just traveled through time and had no time to deal with it. Moreover, it costs a lot of money to repair these buildings. All the valuable things in the sect have been removed by the brothers. How can Qin Ye still have money to repair them?
Of course, these will definitely not be told to Wan Chen. The dignity of the sect and himself must still be maintained.
The three of them walked into the sect, and Qin Ye said to Wu Xuan'er, "Take him to arrange a place to live."
"Yes, senior brother, head master." Wu Xuan'er responded.
Wu Xuan'er took Wan Chen to a building in the north, where the disciples' rest area was. They saw that the place was in a mess, with some daily necessities scattered on the ground.
Wu Xuan'er blushed and explained: "Originally, someone cleaned this place every day, but some changes happened a few days ago, and the cleaning servants temporarily went down the mountain."
Wan Chen nodded and said nothing. He came here to practice. As long as the sect master taught sincerely, he didn't care about anything else.
Wu Xuan'er pointed to a large number of houses in front of her and said, "There is no one here right now, so just choose one."
"Yes, Great Elder." Wan Chen responded and walked in. He found that the disciples' rooms were not very different, so he chose one at random.
Seeing that Wan Chen had chosen a room, Wu Xuan'er said, "Clean the room now. The boss should summon you tomorrow."
After saying that, Wu Xuan'er left in a hurry.
What happened today shocked her. She also realized that her strength was insufficient, and she was determined to break through Xiantian in a short time. Otherwise, if the disciples were stronger than her, she would not have the dignity to be the great elder.
…
Qin Ye returned to the bedroom and hurriedly asked the system: "System, my task of recruiting apprentices has been completed. Where is the reward?"
Because he never heard the system prompt, Qin Ye hurriedly sent Wan Chen away and asked the system.
"Host, the task of recruiting disciples has not been completed yet." The system's voice sounded in Qin Ye's ears.
"System, didn't I accept Wanchen as my disciple? How could it not be completed?" Qin Ye asked with a frown.
"Host, you just brought Wanchen into the sect, and you haven't accepted a disciple yet." The system reminded.
"..." Qin Ye.
Although he made a mistake, Qin Ye is not in a hurry. Wan Chen has already entered the sect. He is like meat on the chopping board. He can be accepted as a disciple at any time. The system reward will not be his yet.
